title: Automatic Elastic Waistband Cutting Machine
description:
Project Overview

Development of a fully automatic elastic waistband cutting machine to replace the conventional manual cutting process.

Previous Process

The elastic waistband cutting operation was performed manually using scissors. Operators had to measure the required length manually before cutting each piece.

Automation Solution

Developed a fully automated cutting machine to integrate the measuring and cutting operations into a single automated process.

The solution was intended to improve process consistency and reduce repetitive manual measuring and cutting activities.

My Contribution

Involved in machine development and automation engineering, from developing the automated process concept to machine implementation.

Implementation

A total of 2 units were developed and implemented.
technologies: Machine Development, Industrial Automation, Automatic Measurement, Automatic Cutting, Electrical Control
